description: This file defines an interface for creating HTTP push request factories, including method signatures for creating HTTP requests and flows, along with a static factory method for instantiation.

classes.name: HttpPushFactory
classes.description: Interface defining methods for creating HTTP request and flow objects for HTTP push mechanism, along with a static factory method.

methods.name: newRequest
methods.description: Creates an HTTP request template for a specified publish target without headers or payload.

methods.name: createFlow
methods.description: Creates a flow for sending HTTP requests and receiving responses, parameterized by system, logger, and type T.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static method to instantiate an HttpPushFactory from a connection, configuration, and logger.
